flags.note: T8 Atraxa reveal with Atraxa #1 already on the battlefield, creature slot: took a 2nd Atraxa (legend rule) over Acererak, and took Aluren in the same reveal. With Acererak, T10 Veil + Show and Tell for Aluren + free Acererak (Lost Mine loop) wins; instead the win came on T14.

Tomb of Annihilation room after Trapped Entry: chose Oubliette, which makes only me discard and sacrifice an artifact, a creature and a land (lost my Atraxa, Hedge Maze, Strand). Veils of Fear then Sandfall Cell makes the opponent at 4 pay a card or a permanent or die, and costs me only life at 20.

Opp cast Veil of Summer with exactly 3 mana left for Show and Tell; B held Daze + Force of Will with 4 lands + uncracked Tarn and passed, then Dazed the Veil-protected Show and Tell (dead). Better: crack Tarn and hard-cast Force on Veil, keep Daze for Show and Tell (both countered), or at least Force pitching Daze on Veil.

T5 after Show and Tell -> Omniscience, opp at 18 with 4 cards, two Acererak in hand, Lost Mine at Dark Pool: passed with free Cast Acererak on the menu. Better: keep looping Acererak through Lost Mine (4 casts per Dark Pool drain) and kill this turn; passing gave UR two turns to block plus double Bolt plus Force at Atraxa.

T7 main 2 with Omniscience and Aluren in play, two Acererak in hand, opp at 18: passed again instead of running the Lost Mine loop to 0. UR then went block plus Bolt, Bolt, Force at Atraxa at end step; Atraxa survived on 6 damage only because Veil of Summer and a free Force answered.

T6 main 2, Wasteland untapped (also offered at prompts 17-22 and 24), opp (Alurentell) has Ancient Tomb, Hedge Maze, Tropical Island: passed. Better: Wasteland the Tropical Island; Maze and Trop were its only G sources and Aluren needs GG, so it could not cast Aluren next turn (it did, and looped Acererak to kill me).

T7, A at 12 with no creatures, B on 2 lands: cast Sand Scout precombat. Alternative: attack first (9 damage, A to 3), then in main 2 Erode its own Cat token, flipping Ajani; Avenger's 0 ability with the red mobilize Warriors out deals 7 (creature count) to A, which is lethal. Please confirm the card text and line. B's own flag on this turn is mis-numbered 682.

T8 (A's turn), A at 1 life, A's Aluren in play, Acererak on the stack: passed with 'Cast Phlage' offered. Aluren lets any player cast creatures of mana value 3 or less free at instant speed, so Phlage's 3 damage on entry wins on the spot. B passed 33 such windows (through seq 135) and lost to the drain loop.

T9 (my 5th turn), at 10 life vs 7 Boros creatures, hand Aluren + Acererak + Show and Tell + cantrips, Island/Maze/Boseiju/Petal untapped, opp 1 card and 1 untapped land: cast Brainstorm (then Ponder, Stock Up, attack) and never cast Aluren. Better: Aluren, then Acererak free on a Lost Mine loop, which wins now; died next turn.

T4 cleanup, discard 1 from Tropical, Ponder, Stock Up x2, Force of Will, Aluren, Atraxa, Acererak (Atraxa already in play, no Show and Tell in hand): discarded Acererak, half of the Aluren combo. Better: discard the second Stock Up or Atraxa #2 (both blue, Force fodder stays). Got away with it when Brainstorm found another Acererak on t8.

T18 at 1 life, Omniscience out, 3 cards in hand: Atraxa reveal took only Ponder and pressed Done, leaving Veil of Summer, Tropical Island, Lotus Petal, Aluren, Omniscience. Better: take one of each type (Veil, Tropical, Petal at least); hand size was no issue.

Stuck on 1 land after Preordain, passed with Mishra's Bauble castable for free (never cast all game, also at 5, 11, 19, 22, 23); cracking it digs a card toward land 2 and adds an artifact for DRC/Heat delirium at no cost.

T4 Stock Up second pick (Ponder already taken), Omniscience + Atraxa in hand, 3 lands (Maze, Tundra, Tropical): took Misty Rainforest over Acererak. Acererak adds the Aluren route (outs 4 -> 8); the Misty ended up a redundant second fetch. Brady batch 2 says not another land.

T6 main 2, Spider-Woman (opp artifacts/creatures enter tapped) on their board, Lotus Petal in hand, no Show and Tell yet: passed without casting Petal. Better: cast it now so it untaps for turn 8 (4 real mana = Brainstorm + Show and Tell); a Petal cast on turn 8 entered tapped and gave nothing.

T4 main 1, land drop already used (Wasteland), no counter in hand, combo opponent on 1 land: cast Brainstorm at sorcery speed and tapped out. Alternative: hold it for A's upkeep or in response to Show and Tell, digging for Force/Daze when it matters (Daze can return the tapped Volcanic). A resolved Show and Tell next turn.

T5 main 1 after playing Tropical (Island, Tundra, Tropical + Petal in hand = exactly {2}{G}{G}): cast Veil of Summer with nothing to protect, leaving 3 mana and one green, so Aluren was dead this turn. Better: pass holding Veil and Petal; next turn Tropical #2, Veil, then Aluren is uncounterable. A misread Aluren as {2}{G}.

T6 with only fetches as lands in hand plus Preordain: played Scalding Tarn first, then Cutter + Preordain, which found Wasteland after the land drop. Preordain first could put Wasteland down this turn on A's only green land (Tropical; Aluren needs GG), at the cost of the Cutter Monk. A's turn-7 Aluren depended on that Tropical.

T1 Ponder saw Island, Lotus Petal, Lotus Petal; hand Trop(played), 2 Petal, Aluren, Show and Tell, Omniscience, no creature or cantrip. Kept (no shuffle), locking dead draws for turns 1, 3, 5. Alternative: shuffle; Trop + 2 Petals already cast Show and Tell T3, and 3 random cards were ~75% to find a creature or cantrip. A never drew a creature and lost.

T12 Main 1 with Wasteland in hand, land drop unused, Alurentell on Island + 2 Ancient Tomb + Petal with Aluren out: passed (and never played it in Main 2). Alternative: Wasteland a Tomb to cut their mana; low impact here but a skipped land drop.

Turn 4 main 1: passed with Mishra's Bauble in hand (skipped it at 7 prompts); casting and cracking it adds artifact as 4th graveyard type, so DRC gets delirium and attacks as a 3/3 flier instead of 1/1, plus a card.

T4 Atraxa reveal after taking Tropical, Veil, Show and Tell, Petal: chose Done with Acererak still offered. Taking it costs one extra cleanup discard (Misty or a Stock Up) and gives the Aluren route its creature; the playbook says take fewer only to skip cards you would discard anyway.

T8 under Omniscience, loop about to start, opp holding 1 card (Swords) with W open: Atraxa reveal Done after Force of Will + Aluren, leaving Acererak, Stock Up and a land. Hand size is irrelevant on the combo turn; a spare Acererak would have covered the legend-rule loss (prompt 77) and Swords on the last copy without needing the Force.

T9 Brainstorm (drew Ponder, Show and Tell, Stock Up) with a Flooded Strand crack to follow: put back Aluren and a Show and Tell, keeping a second Show, a second Atraxa (dead, one already in play) and Stock Up; the crack then shuffled Aluren away. Putting back the duplicates (Atraxa #2 + Show #2) keeps the only loop enabler; Ponder happened to find Acererak and Aluren anyway.

T12 Thundering Falls surveil: binned a second Force of Will while holding Force of Will plus Volcanic Island (no blue card to pitch). Keeping it on top makes Force live (Force pitching Force) against the Aluren / Show and Tell the opponent was known to hold; it did not matter only because A won on T13.

T7 at 6 life, B (8 creatures, 2 red Raptors, last card) cast a 2nd Ajani, Nacatl Pariah with the first in play: passed with Force of Will in hand. Legend rule kills the old Ajani (a Cat) and flips the new one; Avenger's 0 then deals 9 (creature count), lethal and uncounterable. Better: Force pitching Brainstorm (1 life); B is left with 0 cards and the turn-8 Aluren/Acererak kill is untouched. A survived only because B misclicked the +2.

T2 with Wasteland, 2 Volcanic, Falls in hand: played Thundering Falls while Alurentell (on 6 cards) had only Tropical Island. Wasteland on the Tropical leaves them on Petal alone (Aluren needs 4 mana with GG); B's own development could wait. B won anyway by Wasting Ancient Tomb on T4.

T10 played Volcanic Island before Brainstorm; Brainstorm then drew Wasteland with no land drop left to kill the opponent's last land (Tropical). Cantrip first, then choose the land. Harmless here (lethal that turn) but a general sequencing rule.

Misty cracked at B's end step: fetched Savannah instead of Hedge Maze. Maze enters tapped but untaps for my turn, still pays G for Aluren (Maze + City + Petal), adds blue for Show and Tell and surveils 1 before the draw. No impact here, but it is free value the playbook already describes.

Opp's Acererak on the battlefield with its ETB trigger on the stack, B tapped out under opp's Aluren: passed. This was the first window for a free Amped Raptor to discover Swords/Erode and exile Acererak; B waited until p27 (same window one loop later). Cost only one room here.

T6, B cast Cori-Steel Cutter (B had 1 Volcanic up and Daze; I had Hedge Maze open to pay). Holding FoW x2, Veil, Show and Tell, Atraxa: passed. Alternative: Force it pitching the 2nd FoW, still keeping FoW+Veil for next turn's Show and Tell. Passing let the Monk tokens take me 14->7 (5 after Tomb), in Bolt range; both FoW went unused all game.

T2 Brainstorm put-back: chose Acererak (then Ponder), keeping both Atraxas. The second Atraxa is dead with one Show and Tell; Acererak in hand makes a turn-4 Show and Tell for Aluren an immediate win.

T4 Show and Tell resolving: put in Atraxa. Acererak was the known top card and A held Petal + Ponder, B tapped out: Aluren in, Petal-Ponder draws Acererak, free loop wins on turn 4. Atraxa got bounced by Karakas and the win came 4 turns later at 8 life.

T6 with Tundra + City + Petal up: played Tropical first, City sacrificed unused, Stock Up never cast. Stock Up off City + Tundra before the land drop was free (engine cannot float mana). Root of A's own flag p43.

T8 at 14 life, Bolt on stack plus 10 power of attackers: passed and fell to 1, which turned off both Ancient Tombs and Force of Will. Force of Will on the Bolt (pitching Show and Tell, which had no payoff) keeps A at 4; turn 9 then had Tomb + Petal for the second Show and Tell (found by Brainstorm), uncounterable under Veil, into Aluren and the Acererak loop.

T9 at 1 life, dead next turn, Veil resolved (spells uncounterable), land drop unused: passed holding Lotus Petal + Brainstorm. Petal into Brainstorm digs 3 for City of Traitors (Petal + City = Show and Tell for Aluren) or a land plus Petal; passing is a certain loss.

T9, A at 1 life cast Veil of Summer in response to B's Daze on Brainstorm; B held 2 Force of Will and passed. Resolved Veil makes all of A's spells uncounterable that turn and draws a card, so the Forces were blank exactly when A could combo; Force the Veil (pitch the other Force) and Daze stops the Brainstorm.

T4 Show and Tell put-in: chose Atraxa while holding Aluren + Acererak, opp tapped out (lands tapped on its own turn), 3 small creatures. Aluren then free Acererak loops and wins this turn (Bombardment = 3 dmg vs a 5/5); Atraxa died to Erode and the win came 2 turns later. Is Aluren the default here, and does symmetric Aluren vs Boros (free Amped Raptor into Swords) change it?

T2 Hedge Maze surveil, hand Strand, 2 Misty, Brainstorm, Stock Up, Aluren, Acererak: kept a second Stock Up on top. Aluren and Acererak were already in hand and the hand lacked a 4th mana (Tomb/Petal/City); the Stock Up could not be cast before the combo turn and never was. Binning it gives a fresh draw (about 1 in 6 mana source). Brainstorm happened to find Tomb.

B's T5 end step, Flooded Strand search: took Savannah over Hedge Maze. Maze gives the same G for Aluren, also U, enters tapped harmlessly at end step and surveils (existing playbook rule t22/t25). No impact this game.

T6 DRC surveil with known Daze on top, opp hand known to hold S&T/Omniscience/FoW: put Daze in graveyard, which turned on delirium and forced DRC to attack into untapped Atraxa (DRC died, opp +7). Better: keep Daze (drawn via Bauble in opp upkeep) as the free counter for Aluren.

After keeping 1-land Tundra/Petal/Stock Up/FoW/Omniscience/Veil/S&T vs Boros, bottomed Omniscience (only S&T payoff) instead of Veil of Summer (blank vs Boros); keeping Omni gives S&T-Omniscience on T8 (Island + 2 Petals) instead of a T14 win at 5 life.

Elegant Parlor surveil binned Wasteland while knowing A held Omniscience/Acererak/Stock Up on Island + Ancient Tomb; keeping it to Waste Tomb on T11 leaves A unable to Stock Up or Show and Tell before B's board kills.

Turn 3: cast Stock Up with Maze+Island+Petal into a free Daze (opp Volcanic tapped) while Petal #7 sat in hand; casting Petal #7 first (offered at [1]) leaves a real pay-1 spare, or wait to turn 5 with 3 lands + Petal. Stock Up was the hand's only dig and was Dazed.

Misty cracked at opp end step for Tropical Island while Hedge Maze #2 was available (same colours, untaps for my turn, surveil 1 before the draw); with no payoff in hand the free surveil was worth more. Next draw was a dead second Show and Tell.

Opp end step, 11 life facing Murktide+DRC+Cutter, no payoff in hand: passed with Flooded Strand uncracked; cracking for Hedge Maze #2 surveils before the draw to dig for Atraxa/Omniscience for two Show and Tells. Strand was never cracked.
Turn 8 with 3 mana: cast DRC then Cori-Steel Cutter; Cutter first then DRC triggers flurry for a 2/2 haste trample Monk (8 damage instead of 6 and an extra body).

T4, 2 lands (Trop untapped), hand Hedge Maze, Boseiju, Ponder, 2 Stock Up, Show and Tell: played Boseiju before Ponder; better Ponder off Trop first, then Hedge Maze tapped (Boseiju's G had no use this turn), giving two untapped sources on T6 instead of one after the Wasteland.
One-lander (Tundra, Petal, Ponder, Aluren, S&T, 2x Omniscience), no creature, no Force; playbook says 1 land + Ponder = mulligan; keep is tempting for S&T+Omniscience but too many dead cards
Second 7: 3 lands, Petal, Omniscience, Atraxa, Acererak; no cantrip/Show/Aluren. Keep vs go to 6; kept as 3 lands + 2 creatures is better than another mull
Hedge Maze surveil shows Force of Will on top; already hold one FoW and no Show/Aluren/cantrip. Bin it to dig vs keep as 2nd FoW (pitch fodder/protection)

T7, nothing castable (hand Tomb, City, Petal, FoW, Atraxa, Acererak; Island + Savannah out), opp already used one Wasteland: played Ancient Tomb. Alternative: hold it (or play City). The Tomb drew B's 2nd Wasteland and kept Savannah, the only land green source, alive to pay GG for the turn-9 Aluren.
keep 2 lands (Tarn+Wasteland, only one blue source) with Bauble/DRC/Cutter/Daze/Murktide vs mull to 6; opp already on 6

T8 Wasteland vs Alurentell showing Island, Savannah, Ancient Tomb: took Ancient Tomb (A down to 2 mana). Alternative: Savannah, their only green land, so Aluren (2GG) needs Petal plus another green source; Tomb left Show and Tell off the table but Aluren came down next turn via City + Petal.
Wasteland'd their Tomb; now Murktide 3/3 (no counters, exiling 5 lands/artifacts) into possible FoW vs Charm/Bolt to build a bigger Murktide later
Ponder: keep Show and Tell/Hedge Maze/Strand on top (no payoff yet, lands-heavy next draws) vs shuffle for random; kept Show and Tell
T2 opp tapped out (27% Daze, 27% FoW): Tomb + Stock Up with zero spare mana vs Tomb + Brainstorm keeping CC to pay Daze (digs less) vs Maze tapped
Down to Island, 2 mana, opp 2x 3/3 flying DRC + Cutter, me at 10: Boseiju-channel Cutter now (stops Bolt+cantrip flurry lethal) vs Hedge Maze surveil tapped and keep land; Show and Tell not castable
At 4 life vs two 3/3 flyers, 2 lands: crack Misty (-1 life, 3 mana, Show and Tell Atraxa, but at 3 life one unblocked DRC is lethal) vs no crack (dead anyway); no line seems to survive
Life 4, Atraxa lifelink on board, opp 5 open mana + 2 cards: attack first (+7) then Misty+Veil+Show and Tell for 2nd Atraxa (Veil makes it uncounterable) vs hold Veil mana up vs Stock Up

T10 after Veil resolved, 3 mana, Atraxa on board, hand Aluren + Atraxa + Stock Up, no Acererak: Show and Tell for a 2nd Atraxa (legend rule, but a fresh reveal found Acererak/Veil/Petal) vs Show and Tell Aluren alone vs Stock Up. A's report calls it a mistake; it looks right.

Opp at 5, I am at 21 with Aluren+Acererak: Tomb of Annihilation (forces life loss/discard/sacrifice, completes in 4 casts, ends the loop) vs Lost Mine drain loop (4+ casts per life, ~20 casts); chose Tomb
Brainstorm putback: Murktide + (Daze vs DRC#2 vs Cutter); opp on 1 land, combo deck; chose to keep threats+FoW, put back Murktide and Daze, then crack Delta to shuffle
Opp tapped out w/ Ancient Tomb: Wasteland the Tomb + Cutter (2 dmg) vs Tarn + Bauble+Cutter+monk token (4 dmg); chose to deny Tomb

T5 DRC surveil: binned Murktide (the 4th card type, delirium: two 3/3 fliers now) vs keeping it on top as a threat and the only Force of Will pitch. Delirium took A to 3, but the Force stayed dead and the T8 Show and Tell for Atraxa resolved.
Opp cast Veil of Summer then Show and Tell tapped out; Veil should make S&T uncounterable by blue; tried alt-cost Daze anyway (cheap test) vs saving Daze/FoW
Forced DRC attack into untapped lifelink Atraxa (they gain 7 per block); holding Bolt for a Bolt+block+Charm/Heat Atraxa kill vs Bolt face (opp at 10, 9 max dmg even unblocked); no real alternative
At 4 life vs 20, no way to beat Aluren/Acererak loop; Wasteland a Tropical now (opp tapped out) vs holding it; only marginal
2 lands (Savannah, City) no blue source, 2 Omniscience, Acererak, Veil, Brainstorm, no Show/Aluren: slow and clunky vs Force/Daze, mulligan chosen but not certain
Bottom after mull: no creature in hand; bottom Aluren (needs creature) vs Veil (protection) vs Show; kept Show+Veil jam line
T1 on the play: Tomb+Petal into Stock Up now (no Island for Daze yet, only Force) vs Misty+hold; chose Stock Up now
Stock Up 2 of 5 (Trop, Brainstorm, Stock Up, Omniscience, Show): took Omniscience (payoff) + Tropical Island (land #3 for Veil+Show) vs 2nd Show or a cantrip

T2 (my 2nd turn): hand Trop, Misty, FoW, Omniscience, Veil, Show but no creature; Show now (3 mana, no spare vs Daze, no payoff creature) vs wait a turn for Veil+Show with 4 mana: chose wait, play Misty and crack at their end step

T3: land, Veil, Show for Omniscience (no creature in hand, Ponder in hand, Force backed by Ponder pitch) vs Ponder first then Show next turn; jammed with Veil per Brady, hoping free cantrips find a creature

Second Atraxa reveal under Omniscience with 9 cards in hand: took Aluren and Veil, then Done, leaving a land and a Stock Up that would have been free to cast. Brady's rule says take fewer only to avoid discarding to hand size; with free spells, is Stock Up always worth taking?
Opp at 8, no hand; Lost Mine lap (1 drain, Atraxa lethal next turn alone) vs completing Tomb now (5 drain, leaves Acererak+Atropal bodies for redundancy): chose Tomb against playbook default

T1, opp mulliganed to 6 and cast Stock Up off Ancient Tomb plus Lotus Petal; I held Force plus Ponder (one pitch). Passed to save Force for Show and Tell; alternative was Force the Stock Up. It found Omniscience, and Veil later made the saved Force useless against Show.

Opp resolved Show&Tell->Omniscience->Atraxa+Acererak under Veil (uncounterable). I plan: no attack, main2 Preordain+DRC surveil binning Daze for delirium so 3/3 flying DRC can block Atraxa and double-Bolt it; alt was racing/face burn. Close: whole plan may just lose to free FoW + lifelink.

Atraxa attacks; block with delirium 3/3 flying DRC and plan Bolt+Bolt (total 9) to kill it, vs no block (take 7, they gain 7). Opp has free FoW and Veil in hand so plan may be blanked; blocked anyway as only way to remove lifelinker.

Opp FoW'd my Bolt (Atraxa has 3 dmg, need both Bolts). I FoW their FoW pitching my other FoW, knowing they hold Veil of Summer (could make it uncounterable). Alt: save FoWs and let Atraxa live. Chose all-in since otherwise lifelink Atraxa wins anyway.

T3, opp casts Cori-Steel Cutter (5 cards, Volcanic tapped but returnable for Daze, my Maze tapped): passed with 3 Force of Will in hand. Alternative: Force the Cutter pitching the third Force, which was discarded to hand size next turn anyway (prompt 35); the Cutter's Monks were the whole clock that killed me.

T2 vs Cutter+Monk: Tomb then Stock Up (all 3 mana, -2 life, no Daze spare) vs Brainstorm with Tomb spare vs Daze (cheaper in life, digs less). Chose Stock Up for dig and mana efficiency; opp tapped out but 39% FoW/Daze

Facing two growing Monks (4/4,3/3) at 15 life; FoW (pitching FoW) on a face Lightning Bolt: -2 cards for +2 life net, but I am short on mana not cards, and life is my scarce resource vs the Monk clock; alternative keep both FoW to protect Show and Tell

At 2 life, Ancient Tomb unusable (2 dmg), only Maze + fetch = 2 mana: cannot cast Show and Tell/Aluren; no blockers vs two Monks. Basically dead; Daze on my Force of Will with my lands tapped (cast FoW on Bolt on their turn) cost the game - was countering the Bolt with a pitch FoW into possible Daze wrong?
Brainstorm put-back: hand Preordain/Daze/FoW/Bolt/Bolt; kept Bolt,Bolt,Daze (burn clock, opp at 15) vs keeping FoW+Daze as a hard counter shield for their S&T/Aluren turn

T5, combo opp tapped out at 15 with 7 cards, my two Monks (3/3, 2/2) out, hand Daze + 2 Bolt: Bolted face (prowess +2). Alternative: keep both Bolts for reach and Goblin blockers later. Firing it baited Force pitching Force, which Daze beat: 15 -> 2, game.
Keep 3 lands+Force+2 Aluren+Veil with no cantrips/creature/blue pitch card vs Boros, or mull to 6; chose mull since only ~8 creatures+4 Show to find
Changed mind: keep (mana fine, every cantrip/Show/Acererak draw is live) after weighing; close vs mull to 6

T4, opp end step, opp has Voice of Victory and a Boros deck with 4 Wasteland: cracked Misty for Hedge Maze (surveil, untapped on my turn 5, where I cast nothing). Alternative: keep Misty uncracked as a Wasteland decoy until the Aluren turn (playbook: uncracked Misty costs nothing). Tension between two playbook rules when G sources are scarce.

Casting Aluren vs Boros is symmetric (they get free creatures on their turn); only Voice stops them on my turn. I plan to win this turn via Acererak/Dark Pool drain loop (~80 casts for 20 life) - close vs waiting for Show and Tell
Opp at 1 life; chose Tomb of Annihilation first room (each player loses 1) to finish instead of 3 more casts to Dark Pool; opponent cannot respond (Voice)

Turn 6 I tapped out for Ajani (Parlor was my only W source) instead of keeping W up for Swords/Erode; opp then Aluren+Acererak looped (Lost Mine, never completes Tomb) and drains me 1 per cycle with no way to respond. Ajani vs holding Swords was close at the time because opp had passed 2 turns doing nothing.
5 lands (no Ancient Tomb), Veil, Show and Tell but no payoff/cantrip vs fast Boros: keep and draw into payoff vs mulligan to 6

T2 Misty search: took basic Island over Tropical Island (hand: Savannah, Boseiju, City of Traitors). After an Island, three land drops cannot make Aluren's {2}{G}{G}. Trop plus Maze or Savannah plus Tomb or City casts Aluren on turn 6 at 10 life instead of turn 8 at 1. Cost: Trop exposed to a 4-Wasteland Boros deck.
Surveil: keep Aluren on top (Acererak in hand, but GG+4 mana only on turn 8) vs bin it to dig for Atraxa/Omniscience for turn-6 Show and Tell; facing a wide Boros board at 12 life
Life 3 facing ~11 Boros creatures, opp fully tapped out: cast Aluren (tapping Ancient Tomb to 1 life) then loop Acererak Lost Mine drain 63 casts this turn, vs other lines
Keep 2 fetchlands + four 1-2 drops + Phlage vs mull to 6; 2-lander is risky but cheap curve

Turn 7 (prompt 36-44): I tapped out for Sand Scout and swung with everything; opp (at 12) then did Aluren + infinite-ish Acererak/Lost Mine loop draining 1 life per dungeon, I could do nothing with tapped lands. Alternatives: hold Erode/Phlage mana, or Spider-Woman. Close call; judged tempo + Voice lock best.

T5, no Show and Tell or Aluren in hand (Island, Maze, Boseiju out; Tomb, City, 2 Petal, Atraxa in hand): hardcast Acererak using a Lotus Petal (only black source) for one Lost Mine scry. Alternative: keep both Petals as spare mana for a later Show and Tell + Aluren turn. Is a scry worth a Petal vs aggro?

Atraxa reveal vs Boros (Voice of Victory out, opp has no counters): took Aluren, Brainstorm, Ponder, Flooded Strand, Atraxa #2; left Force of Will, Ancient Tomb, Omniscience. Alternative: Ancient Tomb (2 mana next turn) or Force (stops Swords on Atraxa/Acererak on my turn) over the second Atraxa or a cantrip.

Spider-Woman makes my Petal enter tapped so no mana; choose between cracking Strand for Tropical + Brainstorm now vs pass keeping Strand uncracked (Wasteland decoy, shuffle away put-backs next turn). Chose wait.

Opp has 7/7 lifelink Atraxa untapped as blocker, I'm ahead on board but no removal in hand; casting Raptor first hoping its free spell is Swords/Erode vs holding back and not attacking into Atraxa (blocks+gains 7)

T8, opp at 10 with an untapped 7/7 lifelink deathtouch Atraxa and known Aluren + Acererak in hand, my 5 ready attackers + mobilize + 5 energy (one Guide pump): attacked with nothing. Alternative: alpha for ~13 power (opp to about 9 after Atraxa's block lifelinks 7, I lose a creature). Racing vs holding when the combo is known to be in hand.

Atraxa 7/7 lifelink blocks/attacks each turn and no removal: plan to cast 2nd Ajani for energy then attack with only Voice, double-pump it to 7/9 flier to threaten trading with Atraxa, vs waiting for Swords/Erode and not attacking
One-land 7 (Misty) with Brainstorm, Stock Up, Aluren, Show, Atraxa, Acererak on the draw vs Boros w/ 4 Wasteland: keep and dig with Brainstorm vs mulligan to 6; close, kept for power + cantrip
T2 with Island+Tomb (3 mana, 2 lands only): Show and Tell for Atraxa now (ETB digs 10 for lands, eats Swords but gains 7) vs Stock Up for lands first; chose Show for speed vs Boros

Aluren+Acererak loop with opp at 15 and Atraxa on board: Tomb of Annihilation (symmetric damage, ends loop and gives Atropal, Acererak stays) vs Lost Mine drain 1 per 3-4 casts as playbook default; chose Tomb to set up lethal Atraxa swing next turn

T14 main 2 at 30 life vs Boros with Goblin Bombardment, Voice and 5 creatures, hand Tomb/Force/Veil: hardcast Omniscience paying 4 life (two Ancient Tomb taps) with nothing to cast this turn, vs hold it until a turn it does something. B's t17 alpha plus sac pings was exactly A's life; the 4 life was the margin, yet the Omniscience later gave the free Atraxa and Force that won.

Opponent alpha-struck with 9 creatures plus Goblin Bombardment (exact lethal with pings); chose to block Sand Scout (largest ground power) vs Ocelot Pride (the token engine); nothing castable because Voice of Victory stops my spells on their turn
Atraxa 7/7 on their side, they hold known Force of Will + Ponder pitch; Swords now while tapped out (accept FoW 2-for-1) vs bait with Guide first vs wait
Atraxa attacks alone: chump with Spider-Woman now (stay 12) vs take 7 (5 life) and keep SW for later chump; chose safety vs. exposure to reach
Goblin Bombardment drawn vs Atraxa 7/7 lifelink + 27 life opp: cast now under Voice protection and keep building bodies via Ocelot/Guide doubling to sac 7 later vs sac 7 of my 8 now

T12, Acererak attack trigger (opp creates a 2/2 Zombie unless I sacrifice a creature), I had two summoning-sick Cat tokens and Goblin Bombardment: declined (A got a Zombie blocker/attacker) vs sacrifice a Cat.
